release_notes: Remos Player is now public on Google Play
Remos Pro: a one-time purchase that unlocks playing from Home, Search and Favorites, synced lyrics, the Up Next queue and sound settings
Picking a room, Now Playing, playback, volume and TV Autoplay stay free, and you can look around every Pro screen with your own music

announcements.title: Remos is out of beta
announcements.body: Remos Player is now public on Google Play. Thank you to everyone who tested it during the beta: your bug reports and ideas shaped almost every update. As promised, the first 5 testers who applied for free-for-life have received their Remos Pro promo codes by email. Remos keeps growing from here, so please keep the feedback coming. You'll find the support email in Settings › About.
